name: Grizzlefang
title: the Goblin King
objective: Topple Grizzlefang on the Grinning Throne before his horde overruns the realm.
desc: A goblin who found a crown in a ditch and decided it meant something.
doomText: Goblin war-drums echo across the hills. The horde is gathering.
Villages burn on the horizon. Grizzlefang's banners are everywhere.
The horde marches! Grizzlefang himself comes to crush you!

name: Mother Murk
title: the Bog Witch
objective: Break Mother Murk's curse at the Drowned Cauldron before the swamp swallows the realm.
desc: An ancient hag brewing a curse that will drown the world in bog-water.
doomText: The rivers run green. Frogs are singing in a language you almost understand.
The swamp spreads. Whole fields are now marsh, and the dead walk in them.
The Cauldron boils over! Mother Murk rises from the mire to claim you!

name: The Mother of Webs
title: Queen of the Silk Cathedral
objective: Burn the Silk Cathedral and slay the Mother of Webs before her brood hatches.
desc: A spider older than the forest, spinning a web across the whole realm.
doomText: Webs drape the trees. Something huge is moving beneath the canopy.
Her eggs are swelling. Travellers vanish on every road.
The brood hatches! The Mother of Webs descends on you herself!

name: The Hollow King
title: Lord of the Barrow
fortress: the Barrow of the Hollow Crown
objective: Shatter the Hollow Crown in its Barrow before the dead outnumber the living.
desc: A king who refused to die, and now refuses to let anyone else rest either.
doomText: Graveyards are empty. The dead are walking toward the Barrow.
The sun dims at noon. The Hollow King's knights ride at night.
The Crown is whole! The Hollow King rides out to end you!

name: Vex-Morrow
title: the Bone Tyrant
objective: Destroy Vex-Morrow's phylactery in the Necropolis before the Long Night falls.
desc: A lich-king preparing a ritual that will snuff out the sun forever.
doomText: The stars go out one by one. The cultists are chanting louder.
The Long Night is coming. Crops wither and the dead stir.
The ritual completes! Vex-Morrow descends upon you in a storm of bones!

name: Ashmaw
title: the Red Wyrm
objective: Slay Ashmaw in the Ashfang Caldera before the dragon wakes fully and burns the realm.
desc: An ancient dragon stirring from a hundred-year sleep, hungry and furious.
doomText: The mountains smoke. Kobolds swarm the passes, singing of their master.
Ash falls like snow. Ashmaw's shadow has been seen over the towns.
Ashmaw is awake! The dragon descends on you in a storm of fire!

name: The Iron Colossus
title: the Last Legion
objective: Shut down the Iron Colossus in the Rusted Forge before it rebuilds the old empire's army.
desc: An ancient war-machine that woke up and decided the empire never fell.
doomText: The ground thrums. Smoke rises from the old Forge for the first time in centuries.
Iron soldiers patrol the roads, demanding papers nobody has.
The Colossus marches! It comes to 'restore order' — starting with you!
